# LaunchVault

> Real founder stories, checked number by number. Every number carries a label (Verified, Claimed, Sources differ, Live, Wayback or Couldn't verify), a date and a link to its source. Written by LaunchVault. Not financial advice.

## Breakdowns

- [AEO Engine turned an old Amazon ad agency into a $204K month by renaming itself for the AI search wave](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/aeo-engine/): An agency (a company hired to do work for clients) that gets brands to show up in AI answers like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. MRR: $190,513 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [Boothie made $208K in five months by riding the digicam selfie trend on TikTok](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/boothie/): An AI photo app for iPhone and Android that restyles your selfie as film, digicam or photobooth shots. Revenue in Oct 2026: $56,432 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [DM Champ sat near $10K a month for a year, then hit $28K after it changed who it sells to](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/dm-champ/): An AI sales agent that chats with leads and books calls. Agencies (companies that do marketing for clients) can put their own brand on it (white-label it) and resell it. MRR: $135,927 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [Gojiberry's waitlist of 2,000 paid nothing. A rebuild took it to $407K in one month](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/gojiberry/): Finds B2B buyers (people buying for their company) who are showing buying signals on LinkedIn, so sales teams know who to message. MRR: $424,368 (Verified, Aug 14 2026).
- [Mindset reached $24K a month by building on its team's YouTube audience first](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/mindset/): A daily motivation app that wakes you up with famous speeches, with streaks and leaderboards. Revenue in Oct 2026: $30,780 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [Postiz: almost two years under $15K a month, then $431K](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/postiz/): A social media scheduler built by one main developer. Free to self-host (run it on your own server), paid to use hosted. MRR: $430,896 (Verified, Nov 17 2026).
- [Rezi started as a resume template on Reddit and made $216K in October 2026](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/rezi/): An AI resume builder that helps job seekers write resumes that get past hiring software. MRR: $234,707 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [Stencil AI went from $16K to $63K a month in 2026 by fixing one boring job for tattoo artists](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/stencil-ai/): An app that turns a photo, sketch or design into a print-ready tattoo stencil for tattoo artists. Revenue in Oct 2026: $62,976 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [Upscale B2B sold $3 email inboxes to cold-email agencies, then became one, and now makes about $99K a month](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/upscale-b2b/): Runs done-for-you outbound sales campaigns (email, calls, LinkedIn) for B2B companies (businesses that sell to other businesses), and sells the email inboxes those campaigns send from. TrustMRR lists it as "Upscale System LLC". MRR: $140,324 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).
- [Windmill Growth started with a $500-a-month LinkedIn service and now brings in about $118K a month](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/windmill-growth/): A marketing agency (a company hired to do marketing for clients) that grows founders' personal brands, mainly on LinkedIn. MRR: $119,347 (Verified, Nov 18 2026).

## Guides

- [How to read a revenue chart](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/how-to-read-a-revenue-chart/): MRR, all-time revenue, and what a sudden jump on the line actually means.
- [Three ways to start small](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/three-ways-to-start-small/): A family member's problem, a service you can sell now, or a free version people can try. A real example of each.
- [What 'Verified' means on LaunchVault](https://www.launchvault.ca/blog/what-verified-means/): Where our revenue numbers come from, why some are labelled Claimed, and why every number has a date.
